page_title: TOU 2-2 MAR | Toulouse v Marseille 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Clement Turpin is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' 2 - 2 What a GOAL that is! Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Guillaume Restes helpless. He makes it 2:2.
90+3' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' Here comes a substitution. Jean Onana is given a rest as he is replaced by Keyliane Abdallah (Marseille).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cristian Casseres is coming onto the pitch as Yann Gboho (Toulouse) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
82' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Gabriel Suazo laid the ball off to Yann Gboho (Toulouse), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
80' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) replaces Stijn Spierings.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thijs Dallinga departs the field of play to be replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
79' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but Pau Lopez leaps into the air and clears the danger.
79' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) jumps into a tackle and Clement Turpin signals a foul. Toulouse have a free kick.
75' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) replaces Zakaria Aboukhlal.
71' A dangerous towering header by Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
70' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner.
70' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
66' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raimane Daou (Marseille) replacing Michael Murillo.
64' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
59' Joaquin Correa goes off the pitch and Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) comes on.
59' Here is a change. Jordan Veretout is going off and Jean-Louis Gasset gives the last tactical orders to Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
59' A substitution has been made. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang goes off and Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) comes on.
55' Close! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
54' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) whips in a cross from the corner, but Pau Lopez is well positioned and punches the ball away.
54' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
51' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Luis Henrique (Marseille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Marseille have a corner.
47' Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 1 - 1 Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a bullet header from close range into the middle of the net. The score is 1:1.
45+1' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
45+1' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
39' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

38' 0 - 1 The ball is in the back of the net! Jean Onana (Marseille) reacts quickest to get to the rebound near the penalty spot and steers a brilliant header in off the upside of the right post. The score is 0:1.
38' Marseille will take a corner kick.

38' A snap shot by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Guillaume Restes produces a good save to thwart him. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
37' One of the Toulouse players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
33' Michael Murillo (Marseille) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
32' What a strike! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) hits the left post from the free kick.
31' Clement Turpin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse). Marseille get a free kick.
29' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
29' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joaquin Correa (Marseille), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Half-chance! Joaquin Correa (Marseille) plays a pass into the box, but Guillaume Restes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
21' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
20' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
19' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
16' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Pau Lopez makes a comfortable save.
10' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is adjudged offside.
10' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
9' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
8' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Toulouse get a corner.
5' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in a cross from the corner, but Pau Lopez reads it well and gathers the ball.

5' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.

Marseille will kick the game off.
